feature.name: depth_shape_ratio
feature.definition: L1_size / sum(L1_size..L5_size) on the entry side (ask for longs, bid for shorts)
feature.note: Measures how concentrated top-of-book depth is at L1. Low = thin probe quote in front of real depth. High = L1 dominates the top-5 stack.

threshold.interpretation: Pass (allow entry) when entry-side DSR < 0.135. Reject when DSR >= 0.135.
threshold.derivation: Fit on 6 days (2025-12-01 through 2025-12-09, n=92), swept 0.03-0.20 in 0.005 steps, selected by max lift with >=5 fail-side trades.

exclusions.policy: Do not apply this gate on sessions containing a scheduled macro release. Mark those sessions as gate_ineligible. This is a fixed list — do not expand it with ad-hoc additions without a separate research note.

known_exclusion_dates.note: 26 of 35 entries clustered 19:02-20:11 UTC (2-3pm ET post-FOMC chop). DSR signal inverts: market maker quote withdrawal on both sides mimics thin-book signal.

evidence.follow_through_definition: mfe_ticks >= 1.0 (price moves at least 1 tick in trade direction after entry)
evidence.day_consistency: Signal present in 7/8 usable days. 12-10 (FOMC) inverts — excluded. 12-01 (n=10) too small to read.

interpretation.what_it_does: Cuts the bottom ~40% of entries — those with 85% immediate-failure rate — from execution. Passing trades still only follow through ~34% of the time on a 1-tick definition, so this is a stop-bleeding filter, not a high-conviction signal.
interpretation.mechanism: Thin L1 (low DSR) = probe quote sitting in front of real depth. Once L1 is absorbed at entry, less immediate book resistance above/below. High DSR = L1 dominates the stack, meaning L1 absorption still leaves a thick book that can push price back.
interpretation.what_it_does_not_do: Does not improve payoff magnitude among winners. TP optimization requires a separate layer of research on the 110 passing trades.

next_research.question: Among the 110 passing trades (DSR < 0.135, excl FOMC), do any L2-10 features predict magnitude of favorable excursion (fav_excursion ticks) among winners?
next_research.purpose: TP optimization — find where to set exit on winning trades to move from filter-only to positive EV.
